svg.title: B04 AURORA VEIL — Ionospheric Absorption Atlas engineering architecture
svg.desc: The architecture makes instrument power, platform geometry and modeled event comparisons explicit. The spacecraft branch is conditional on verified metadata, and no ground measurement is automatically interpreted as spacecraft-link attenuation.
